headline: Pixel 11 specs and price leak with no surprises
summary: Pixel 11 specs and price leak ahead of August 12th event. Report suggests a $100 price hike, starting at $899. Expected to feature 256GB base storage.

headline: Angela Nissel faces down grief with a laugh
summary: Angela Nissel's new memoir, "Good Grief, Pass the Bread, Mom Is Dead," combines grief and gallows humor. The book explores caring for a terminally ill parent. Nissel uses dark humor to navigate difficult emotional experiences.

headline: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
summary: Fenix Flexin's solo track "Rubberz" hit Billboard Hot 100. Questions arose quickly about the song's potential AI origins. Speculation suggests the song might be largely AI-generated.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak racks up millions of views
summary: Bootleg of "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" leaked on X for seven hours. The leak garnered over 5.9 million views and 143,000 likes. Disney is now actively pulling down reposts of the film.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" broke a major box office record. The film earned a massive $168 million on its opening day domestically. It surpassed "Avengers: Endgame" for the biggest domestic opening ever.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: First official cast photo for "Game of Thrones: The Mad King" stage play released. The portrait features King Aerys II, Rhaegar Targaryen, and Young Ned Stark. More cast members for the play have been unveiled.

headline: Vincent Pastore, The Sopranos Actor, Dies at 80
summary: Actor Vincent Pastore, known for "The Sopranos," passed away at 80. He famously played Salvatore Bonpensiero in the iconic TV series. Pastore's death marks the loss of a key figure from the groundbreaking show.

headline: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
summary: FromSoftware shared a cryptic social media post, sparking fan speculation. Players hope the post hints at new "Elden Ring" DLC, specifically for Godwyn. This comes two years after the "Shadow of the Erdtree" expansion.

headline: EU calls emergency meeting to discuss Ceuta migrant crossings
summary: The EU has convened an emergency meeting regarding migrant influx in Ceuta. Tense exchanges occurred between Spain and other EU states. The discussion aims to address the surge in migrant crossings into the enclave.

headline: Trump says he is cancelling strikes on Iran subject to 'rapidly' making deal
summary: US President Trump announced he is canceling planned strikes on Iran. The cancellation is contingent on "rapidly" making a deal. This follows media reports of impending intense US strikes over the weekend.

headline: A bruising 24 hours - what next for Fifa and under-pressure Infantino?
summary: Fifa President Gianni Infantino faces growing pressure after a "bruising 24 hours." Questions are being raised about his ability to survive as president. The future of Fifa leadership hangs in the balance.

headline: Young guns for hire - the teenage hitmen recruited to kill across Europe
summary: A network known as The Foxtrot Network employs teenage hitmen. They are reportedly responsible for approximately 35 murders across Europe. The group uses "violence-as-a-service" tactics.
